import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class P851C_Variant1
{
    static double epsilon = 1e-9;
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int count = scanner.nextInt();
        if (count > 11)
        {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        int[][] data = new int[count][5];
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
            {
                data[i][j] = scanner.nextInt();
            }
        }
        ArrayList<Integer> resultIndices = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            boolean isGood = true;
            outerLoop:
            for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
            {
                if (j == i) continue;
                for (int k = j + 1; k < count; k++)
                {
                    if (k == i) continue;
                    Vector vec1 = new Vector(data[i], data[j]);
                    Vector vec2 = new Vector(data[i], data[k]);
                    double angleBetween = Math.acos(vec1.prod(vec2) / (vec1.mag() * vec2.mag()));
                    if (angleBetween < Math.PI / 2 - epsilon)
                    {
                        isGood = false;
                        break outerLoop;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (isGood)
                resultIndices.add(i + 1);
        }
        System.out.println(resultIndices.size());
        for (int index : resultIndices)
            System.out.println(index);
    }
    static class Vector
    {
        int[] components = new int[5];
        Vector(int[] a, int[] b)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            {
                components[i] = b[i] - a[i];
            }
        }
        double mag()
        {
            double sumSquares = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < components.length; i++)
            {
                sumSquares += components[i] * components[i];
            }
            return Math.sqrt(sumSquares);
        }
        int prod(Vector v)
        {
            int dotProduct = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < components.length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += components[i] * v.components[i];
            }
            return dotProduct;
        }
    }
}
